As per the order dated 11.02.2025, learned counsel for the State has produced the letter no.609/LA/KHD/25 dated 02.04.2025 of the Land Acquisition Officer, Khordha, wherein it is mentioned that Designation: Senior Stenographer Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Date: 08-May-2025 18:44:51 construction of 100 feet master plan road in village Jagamara vide L.A.
Case No.14/2008 of L.A.O., Khordha and an amount of Rs.64,05,511/- (rupees sixty four lakhs five thousand five hundred eleven) was awarded towards compensation due to apportionment issue,
compensation amount could not be disbursed to the land losers and subsequently, the matter was referred to Civil Court under section 30 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for adjudication.

The compensation amount of Rs.64,05,511/- (rupees sixty four lakhs five thousand five hundred eleven)
to that effect has been deposited by the L.A.O., Khordha in Allahabad Bank (Khordha Branch) vide cheque no.997498 dated 26.11.2011 before the Civil Court.

The learned Civil Judge (Sr. Division),
Bhubaneswar in judgment dated 18.04.2024 has been pleased to allow the L.A. Misc. Case No.18 of 2014 in holding therein that the petitioner is entitled for compensation in respect of her purchased land measuring Ac0.040 decimal and that on verification of the cash book register and Allahabad Bank pass book in connection with aforesaid matter, it was found that an amount of Rs.64,05,511/-
(rupees sixty four lakhs five thousand five hundred eleven) has already been withdrawn from the account of L.A.O., Khordha on 22.05.2012 and deposited in the account of learned Civil Court and Rukmini Panda vs State Of Orissa on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190687544/

sentences.text: 1 that fact has already been intimated to the learned Civil Judge (Sr. Division), Bhubaneswar vide letter no.298 dated 02.03.2024 & letter no.661 dated 25.06.2024 are annexed to the letter, which is presented before us.
The said written instruction is taken on record.

In view of such state of affairs, there can be no difficulty on the part of the learned Civil Judge (Sr.
Division), Bhubaneswar to release the amount to which, the petitioner is entitled to get as compensation for acquisition of her land.
Let the petitioner appear in the 2nd National Lok Adalat, which is scheduled to be held on 10.05.2025 before the learned Civil Judge (Sr. Division), Bhubaneswar in the aforesaid case and necessary order of payment shall be made in her favour on that very date.
Let a copy of the order be communicated to the learned Civil Judge (Sr. Division), Bhubaneswar by the learned Registrar (Judicial) forthwith along with the letter dated 02.04.2025 and the connected documents which are produced before us.

With these observations and directions, the writ petition stands disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
Pending application (s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
